scenario: stuck on the 48th floor of a luxury apartment building with dead power
part1_script: A luxury penthouse is just a glass cage when the power dies. You are forty-eight floors above the ground. The water pumps shut off at midnight. You filled three bathtubs with eighty gallons before the dry pipes rattled. The three express elevators do not work. You wedged four steel bolts into the fire door at 3:15 AM. Nine hundred sixty concrete steps separate your floor from the street. Down there, four hundred infected pace across broken lobby glass. At 4:00 AM, the emergency generator suddenly roars to life. Every hallway light flashes white and the deafening sirens scream. Your bolted stairwell door violently snaps inward under fifty bodies. Comment Part 2 if you want to see how you survive.
